Question 8
?

At each point P on a particular curve, the derivative y′(x) is inversely proportional to the distance from P to the origin. What differential equation describes this curve?

a
y′=kx2+y2
b
y′=kx2
c
y′=kx2+y2
d
y′=kx2+y2
e
y′=ky2
